lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਨੁ ਪਵਨ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਵਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasan pavan door kar bavare ||
lines.translation: Abandon your Yogic postures and breath control exercises, O madman.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਬਵਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhod kapat nit har bhaj bavare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Renounce fraud and deception, and meditate continuously on the Lord, O madman. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਤੂ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jih too jaachahi so tribhavan bhogee ||
lines.translation: That which you beg for, has been enjoyed in the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੇਸੌ ਜਗਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥੨॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer kesau jag jogee ||2||8||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, the Lord is the only Yogi in the world. ||2||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਨੑਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: inhi maaiaa jagadees gusaaee tumhre charan bisaare ||
lines.translation: This Maya has made me forget Your feet, O Lord of the World, Master of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿੰਚਤ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਨ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੇਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ki(n)chat preet na upajai jan kau jan kahaa karahi bechaare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Not even a bit of love wells up in Your humble servant; what can Your poor servant do? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਫੰਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhrig tan dhrig dhan dhrig ih maaiaa dhrig dhrig mat budh pha(n)nee ||
lines.translation: Cursed is the body, cursed is the wealth, and cursed is this Maya; cursed, cursed is the clever intellect and understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਆਪ ਬਚੰਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: is maaiaa kau driR kar raakhahu baa(n)dhe aap bacha(n)nee ||1||
lines.translation: Restrain and hold back this Maya; overcome it, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਖੇਤੀ ਕਿਆ ਲੇਵਾ ਦੇਈ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਝੂਠੁ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa khetee kiaa levaa deee parapa(n)ch jhooth gumaanaa ||
lines.translation: What good is farming, and what good is trading? Worldly entanglements and pride are false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਬਿਗੂਤੇ ਆਇਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਿਦਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer te a(n)t bigoote aaiaa kaal nidaanaa ||2||9||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, in the end, they are ruined; ultimately, Death will come for them. ||2||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰੀਰ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਭੀਤਰੇ ਆਛੈ ਕਮਲ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: sareer sarovar bheetare aachhai kamal anoop ||
lines.translation: Within the pool of the body, there is an incomparably beautiful lotus flower.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੋ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: param jot purakhotamo jaa kai rekh na roop ||1||
lines.translation: Within it, is the Supreme Light, the Supreme Soul, who has no feature or form. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man har bhaj bhram tajahu jagajeevan raam ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O my mind, vibrate, meditate on the Lord, and forsake your doubt. The Lord is the Life of the World. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਦੀਸਈ ਨਹ ਦੀਸੈ ਜਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavat kachhoo na deesaee nah deesai jaat ||
lines.translation: Nothing is seen coming into the world, and nothing is seen leaving it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਤਹੀ ਜੈਸੇ ਪੁਰਿਵਨ ਪਾਤ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jah upajai binasai tahee jaise purivan paat ||2||
lines.translation: Where the body is born, there it dies, like the leaves of the water-lily. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਜੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mithiaa kar maaiaa tajee sukh sahaj beechaar ||
lines.translation: Maya is false and transitory; forsaking it, one obtains peaceful, celestial contemplation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੰਝਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੩॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer sevaa karahu man ma(n)jh muraar ||3||10||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, serve Him within your mind; He is the Enemy of ego, the Destroyer of demons. ||3||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran kaa bhram gaiaa gobid liv laagee ||
lines.translation: The illusion of birth and death is gone; I lovingly focus on the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat su(n)n samaaniaa gur saakhee jaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In my life, I am absorbed in deep silent meditation; the Guru's Teachings have awakened me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਸੀ ਤੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਧੁਨਿ ਕਾਸੀ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaasee te dhun oopajai dhun kaasee jaaee ||
lines.translation: The sound made from bronze, that sound goes into the bronze again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਸੀ ਫੂਟੀ ਪੰਡਿਤਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaasee phootee pa(n)ditaa dhun kahaa(n) samaaee ||1||
lines.translation: But when the bronze is broken, O Pandit, O religious scholar, where does the sound go then? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਸੰਧਿ ਮੈ ਪੇਖਿਆ ਘਟ ਹੂ ਘਟ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: trikutee sa(n)dh mai pekhiaa ghat hoo ghat jaagee ||
lines.translation: I gaze upon the world, the confluence of the three qualities; God is awake and aware in each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਮਾਚਰੀ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aisee budh samaacharee ghat maahi tiaagee ||2||
lines.translation: Such is the understanding revealed to me; within my heart, I have become a detached renunciate. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਆਪ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤੇਜ ਤੇਜੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap aap te jaaniaa tej tej samaanaa ||
lines.translation: I have come to know my own self, and my light has merged in the Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੩॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer ab jaaniaa gobid man maanaa ||3||11||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, now I know the Lord of the Universe, and my mind is satisfied. ||3||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਹਿ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਡੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal jaa kai ridai basahi so jan kiu dolai dev ||
lines.translation: When Your Lotus Feet dwell within one's heart, why should that person waver, O Divine Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੌ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਜਸੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanau sabh sukh nau nidh taa kai sahaj sahaj jas bolai dev || rahaau ||
lines.translation: I know that all comforts, and the nine treasures, come to one who intuitively, naturally, chants the Praise of the Divine Lord. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਜਉ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖੈ ਕੁਟਿਲ ਗਾਂਠਿ ਜਬ ਖੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: tab ih mat jau sabh mahi pekhai kutil gaa(n)th jab kholai dev ||
lines.translation: Such wisdom comes, only when one sees the Lord in all, and unties the knot of hypocrisy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਅਟਕੈ ਲੈ ਨਰਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਤੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: baara(n) baar maaiaa te atakai lai narajaa man tolai dev ||1||
lines.translation: Time and time again, he must hold himself back from Maya; let him take the scale of the Lord, and weigh his mind. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਉਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਾਸੁ ਨ ਝੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah uhu jaai tahee sukh paavai maaiaa taas na jholai dev ||
lines.translation: Then wherever he goes, he will find peace, and Maya will not shake him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀਓ ਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥੨॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer meraa man maaniaa raam preet keeo lai dev ||2||12||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, my mind believes in the Lord; I am absorbed in the Love of the Divine Lord. ||2||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval baanee bhagat naamadev jee kee ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphal janam mo kau gur keenaa ||
lines.translation: The Guru has made my life fruitful.
